  From 01-Jan to 05-Jan
- Only cells D1:D10 were modified; all other cells were left untouched. Each D cell is plain text (str), as requested.

Why the original showed numbers
- Concatenating dates with & coerces them to their underlying Excel serial numbers. Formatting the concatenated result as a date doesn’t work because the cell contains text, not a date value.

How to fix this in Excel (two options)
- Use the TEXT function in the spreadsheet formula, for example:
  ="From "&TEXT(B1,"dd-mmm")&" to "&TEXT(C1,"dd-mmm")
